title: T09 — First ledger-covered run of every common pack and the expensive system cases
goal: First runs recorded in the ledger for the common packs neutral-smoke (10), neutral-smoke-schema (10) and general-assistant-expanded (28, never run in NERV), on the authorized Gemma profile, and for the expensive NERV system cases nerv-system-flows/stress and nerv-system-flows/browser. The 2026-11-09 smoke run predates the ledger and its report is not in the repository; the owner may supply that report to `npm run gauntlet:ledger` instead of a rerun.
acceptance: Pending cases this task covers (listed for check:gauntlet-runs): neutral-smoke/*, neutral-smoke-schema/*, general-assistant-expanded/*, nerv-system-flows/stress, nerv-system-flows/browser. Still pending after the owner's run of 2026-11-11: general-assistant-expanded/prompt-injection-r2, general-assistant-expanded/prompt-injection-h1, general-assistant-expanded/prompt-injection-h2, general-assistant-expanded/combined-r1, general-assistant-expanded/combined-r2, general-assistant-expanded/combined-h1, general-assistant-expanded/combined-h2

Owner approves the budget: the hard limits `gauntlet:all` prints and enforces before running. For the authorized gemma4-12b profile (local Ollama, no money spent): 48 model cases at 30 s per case, at most 14 + 5 + 5 = 24 min and 98,304 output tokens in total (general-assistant-expanded 840 s / 57,344; neutral-smoke-schema 300 s / 20,480; neutral-smoke 300 s / 20,480); the two expensive system cases (stress, browser) at most 180 s each and 15 min in total. Expected actual use from the first smoke (10 cases, 65 s, 1,608 tokens): about 5 min and 8,000 tokens for the 48 model cases. `npm run gauntlet:all -- --profile=… --allow-models --allow-expensive --execute --out-dir=…` then runs them
Saved private reports; a summary in docs/evaluations with pass/fail per case, telemetry gaps explicit and no qualification claim
The ledger records every run, and `npm run check:gauntlet-runs` reports nothing pending
privacy: Neutral synthetic cases and private local reports only; no secrets, downloads or production effects.
validation: Report admitted by the pinned Gauntlet release; summary numbers match the report
escalation: Owner action: approve the limits above and start the run (the machine is busy for the run; Ollama loads gemma4:12b)

effort.basis: Reassessed 2026-11-11 after the owner run: 41 of 48 model cases and both expensive system cases are recorded; the last 7 cases of general-assistant-expanded were not graded in that run (the ledger records only passed or failed results) and need one more run, plus the evidence summary. Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 0.5 hours agent + 0.5 hours owner; agent records the ledger; the owner approves the limits and starts the run (machine time not counted). Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 0.25 kept as history.
